name: Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and red, charged at the top with the city arms of Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler (a black eagle on yellow beneath a crown, with a cross).
history: The city bears an official seal, arms and a flag; the arms were granted by the Bezirksregierung on 15 October 1971, the imperial crown referring to the lordship of Landskron.

features.role: Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler arms — eagle, crown and cross
